title: Cusco Express
short_description: Cusco – Sacred Valley – Ollantaytambo – Machu Picchu
long_description: Experience an unforgettable 3-day adventure in Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire. This express itinerary includes the city's highlights and the world wonder Machu Picchu, perfect for travelers with limited time.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets, and professional guide.
seo_title: Cusco Express 3D/2N – Machu Picchu & Sacred Valley | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Cusco Express 3-Day Tour: Explore Cusco, the Sacred Valley, and Machu Picchu. Perfect short trip package including tickets, transportation, and a professional guide.
seo_keywords: cusco express, machu picchu express tour, 3 day cusco tour, sacred valley tour, short machu picchu trip, cusco travel package, gt peru travel

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Cusco & Acclimatization
days.text: Pick-up at the airport and transfer to your hotel. Free afternoon for acclimatization. Optional visit to the Qosqo Native Art Center to enjoy traditional dances.

days.title: Day 2: Machu Picchu
days.text: Early departure to Ollantaytambo to board the panoramic train to Aguas Calientes. Guided bus ascent to Machu Picchu for a complete tour of the main viewpoints and temples. Free time and afternoon return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 3: Airport Transfer
days.text: Breakfast at the hotel. At the scheduled time, transfer to the airport for your return flight. End of services.
